tract.translation_before: Praise the Lord, all you nations; praise Him together, all you peoples. For His mercy has been confirmed upon us, and the truth of the Lord remains forever.
tract.translation_after: Praise the Lord, all you nations; praise Him together, all you peoples. For His mercy toward us has proved strong, and the truth of the Lord remains forever.

word_fields.explanation: We ask God to command both our rescue from eternal condemnation and our inclusion in the flock of His chosen. Both outcomes depend on the same command, despite their separation in the Latin order.

translations.pl: Tę więc ofiarę naszej służby, a także całej Twojej rodziny, którą składamy Tobie także za tych, których raczyłeś odrodzić z wody i Ducha Świętego, udzielając im odpuszczenia wszystkich grzechów, prosimy, Panie, abyś łaskawie przyjął,
translations.en: Therefore, Lord, we ask that You graciously accept this offering of our service and also of Your entire family, which we offer to You also on behalf of those whom You graciously regenerated from water and the Holy Spirit, granting them remission of all sins,

s01.narrative: Kapłan trzyma rozłożone ręce nad darami i mówi:

s05.translation: i nasze dni uporządkował w Twoim pokoju, a także nakazał, byśmy zostali uwolnieni od wiecznego potępienia i zaliczeni do trzody Twoich wybranych.

s01.narrative: Holding his outstretched hands over the gifts, the priest says:

s05.translation: and order our days in Your peace, and command that we be rescued from eternal condemnation and counted in the flock of Your chosen.
